name: Tracker
descriptor: A number recorded per day, and what it adds up to: a streak, an average, a goal, a week of bars. Habits, water, weight, mood, sleep, BP, workouts.
verify_checks: derived: a derive function is emitted
chart: inline svg is emitted, with no library
pros: the streak is the cheapest motivation a small app can offer
one number a day is the lowest-friction input there is
the average and the goal do the thinking, so the user does not
the sparkline answers 'how has this week gone' in one glance
cons: a missed day breaks the streak, and some people stop logging after that
one metric per app: a second tracker needs a second app
the window is a fixed N days, so a month view is not available yet
no reminders, so the habit still depends on the user remembering
best_for: one number a day, against a goal the user sets once
avoid_if: the value only makes sense as part of a longer record, or several metrics need tracking together
